name: com.foldlaboratories/art
title: Fold Laboratories Art Catalogue
description: Original art from galleries and artists: search, details, delivered prices and checkout links.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Without it you are served as an unidentified agent: search, full artwork detail and availability all work, with clean display copies of a work's images where its seller's agreement provides for them, otherwise a watermarked, downscaled preview of each work's primary image, and a per-minute rate limit. Tokens go to a named agent operator: send 'Bearer <token>' for every image at full size and no per-minute limit. Requests signed with Web Bot Auth are recognised, and an operator Fold approves is served as a token's holder is. Request a token at https://foldlaboratories.com/agents.
